narrative_engine.thesis: trend up context (H4 stack up · D1 stack tangled · EMA spread 3.44 ATR · price holds above Day VWAP) set the LONG bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 0.1014-0.1121 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip) — the trigger is still pending. Risk is defined beyond 0.0902; the first objective pays 2.12R at 0.1178.

plan.triggerRule: await bullish footprint confirmation (absorption / strong divergence / trap) or wall+CVD confluence at 0.1014-0.1121
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 0.0902 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)
